memory.question: Collect source-linked evidence for intermittent payment-service failures.
memory.reported_symptoms: Monitoring reports intermittent payment failures and elevated latency from 14:00 UTC.
assumptions: All observations and change times are mock data for this lesson.

observations.statement: v2.4.1 changed connection_timeout_ms from 300 to 30 at 13:55 UTC.
Since 14:00 UTC, failing requests return 504 upstream_connect_timeout at connect_elapsed_ms=30.
Independent connection probes range from 12 to 42 ms; some exceed 30 ms but none exceed 300 ms.
Database pool utilization is 40%; DNS and load-balancer checks pass.
Cache memory is 91%; detector suggests a memory leak with 94% anomaly confidence; impact was not assessed.
Sampled failing payment traces time out on payment-processor connections and contain no cache call.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: Possible cache memory leak impacting payments

open_questions: What is the relationship between connection failures and the configuration change?
Do unsampled payment paths depend on the cache?
